thread:
mohit: quick check — looking at onboarding elmwood-9b (upstream release). license file says 'Academic-Research-Only (ARO) v0.9'. plan was to int8 quantize and roll into staging for hosted API perf tests. allowed? :thinking_face:
emily: my initial read: ARO usually blocks commercial hosting. need legal on this.
raj: did some quick quant experiments this morning — int8 w/ our kernels: perf latency down 18%, Token throughput +22%. quality delta on our prompt set ~-1.2% win@mmlu (not great but maybe acceptable). snippet: `MMLU: fp16 74.3 -> int8 73.1`
anna (legal): tagging in — ARO is a research-only restriction. key bit to watch for: if the licensor forbids "providing model as a service" that generally precludes hosted APIs/paid endpoints. can you paste the exact license text?
mohit: pasted the license excerpt below.
```
Academic-Research-Only (ARO) v0.9
You are granted a license to use the Model for non-commercial academic and research purposes only. Distribution, sublicensing, and providing access to the Model as a service are prohibited without prior written consent from the Licensor.
```
anna (legal): thanks — that line is decisive: "providing access to the Model as a service are prohibited". so hosted API = no. Dedicated/reserved capacity for paying customers? also no if we're "providing access" to third parties.
anna (legal): options: 1) request a commercial/hosting license from upstream; 2) run internal R&D only under NDA (research allowed internally); 3) host behind a contract where customer obtains direct license from upstream (complicated).
raj: for internal research experiments we can keep a gated deployment in our R&D VPC (no external endpoints) and flag model as research-only in catalog. I already spun an internal-only test endpoint for offline evals.
legal-bot: filing request: created legal ticket #LIC-2026 to contact upstream and request hosting/commercial permission.
emily: actionables: - stop any hosted rollout - mark elmwood-9b as "research-only" in model-catalog + UI badge - add quant results and eval summary to onboarding doc - legal to pursue license clarification (LIC-2026)
mohit: copying eval artifacts to onboarding PR now, will rollback any hosted config.
ml-onboarding-bot: note added to model registry: elmwood-9b -> status: RESEARCH_ONLY, ticket: LIC-2026
anna (legal): one nuance — if upstream provides an explicit separate license exception for quantized derivatives we might be able to ship quantized weights. but you still need written permission for serving. I'll push that ask in LIC-2026.
raj: heads-up: if we get permission to host, int8 artifacts are reproducible and we can bake them into the model bundle. perf numbers look good.
emily: ok — until legal confirms, no hosted or public-facing embeddings/generation endpoints. internal experiments ok w/ access controls.
mohit: understood. stopping hosted onboarding now. thanks all :thumbsup:
